R. Q. 2 تَزَعْزَعَ It became moved, agitated, shaken, or put into a state of motion or commotion: (S, K:) [or it became moved, agitated, shaken, &c., vehemently:] quasi-pass. of زَعْزَعَتْهُ الرِّيحُ. (TA.) ―
-b2- [And hence,] تَزَعْزَعَتِ الإِبِلُ (tropical:) The camels went roughly, or violently, being so driven, or urged on. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
